news.title:

news.title:
CSB Bank shares rose 6% after Q4 results showed 25% core income growth and improved asset quality.
Gross NPA fell to 1.66% (from 1.96%), Net NPA to 0.4%; provisions dipped, but lower other income capped profit.
news.summary:
CSB Bank shares rose 6% after Q4 results showed 25% core income growth and improved asset quality.
Gross NPA fell to 1.66% (from 1.96%), Net NPA to 0.4%; provisions dipped, but lower other income capped profit.

news.title:
CSB Bank's Board approved audited financial results for Q4 and FY 2026, showing a net profit of ₹63,318 lakh.
The bank's capital adequacy ratio stood at 20.7%, and gross NPAs at 1.66% as of March 31, 2026.
news.summary:
CSB Bank's Board approved audited financial results for Q4 and FY 2026, showing a net profit of ₹63,318 lakh.
The bank's capital adequacy ratio stood at 20.7%, and gross NPAs at 1.66% as of March 31, 2026.
